base_properties.human_readable: Catastrophe-Memory Ritual Cycle — Operational Competence Reading

omegas.question: This constraint is one reading (operational_competence_reading) of the catastrophe_memory_transmission kernel; what would the sibling readings change structurally if adopted instead?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Adopting symbol_continuity_reading relocates the beneficiary to present identity-bearers and tolerates high theater as intrinsic good; adopting hybrid_embedded_reading denies symbol/substance separability and forbids yield-based pruning of elements. Each adoption changes epsilon, the victim set, and the viable type.
omegas.impact: Under symbol_continuity_reading the theater_ratio ceases to be a defect signal; under hybrid_embedded_reading the symbol_processing_participants victim class dissolves (fidelity alone transmits capacity). This file's classification is valid only within the operational reading.
omegas.description: Committer structure: reading-indexed classification of a contested kernel.

omegas.question: Does annual ritual rehearsal actually produce measurable survival-competence gains — faster departure under threat, better scarcity endurance, earlier threat recognition — relative to communities without practice continuity?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Comparative disaster-behavior studies of communities with intact versus broken ritual-continuity facing comparable disruptions; retrospective analysis of flight timing and resource management in documented persecutions; controlled studies of embodied rehearsal versus written-instruction retention.
omegas.impact: A null result removes this reading's referent: the arrangement would revert toward the symbol_continuity sibling, the claimed rope loses its coordination-function warrant, and the residual time cost becomes uncompensated extraction.
omegas.description: Whether the operational-yield claim is empirically supported.

omegas.question: Is the cost-without-yield position of symbol-processing participants a structural product of the arrangement, or an individual comprehension failure the arrangement merely fails to prevent?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Test whether the arrangement's own pedagogy (transmitter instruction, liturgical gloss) reliably flags the operational layer for ordinary participants; if the training function is opaque by design or neglect, the asymmetry is structural.
omegas.impact: If structural, the mild extraction asymmetry is a property of the constraint and pushes computed classification toward tangled_rope territory; if individual, the victim declaration describes noise and the rope reading stands cleanly.
omegas.description: Whether the declared victim class is constraint-produced or user-error.

omegas.question: With suppression_requirement fallen to 0.24 yet the cycle persisting, what now holds the arrangement up — voluntary identity-carried uptake (healthy rope) or institutional inertia with theatrical maintenance (piton drift)?
omegas.resolution_mechanism: Track whether operational engagement (questions asked, children taught the departure logic, scarcity practices enacted) correlates with observance rates, or whether observance persists while engagement empties.
omegas.impact: Identity-carried persistence confirms the rope claim; empty-form persistence with rising theater would mark the early piton trajectory and eventually support a mandatrophy-resolved finding.
omegas.description: Distinguishing voluntary rope persistence from inertial piton drift.

commentary.narrative_context:
This story authors ONE reading of the catastrophe_memory_transmission kernel: the operational_competence_reading, on which the annual catastrophe-memory ritual cycle (Passover's rapid-departure elements, Tisha B'Av's scarcity rehearsal, the memorial-fast calendar) functions as a training technology — storing pattern recognition, resource coordination, and threat-assessment procedure in embodied, annually refreshed form. The epsilon referent is the standing arrangement under contest — the actual annual observance cycle as practiced — assessed by this reading's own operational lights, never by the idealized training regimen it endorses. The claim/metric gap is deliberate and is the datum: the constraint is CLAIMED as rope (a genuine coordination mechanism whose participants are net beneficiaries), while the authored metrics describe a practice whose theater share has climbed steadily and whose mild extraction grows as operational comprehension thins. The engine measures that divergence; this file does not reconcile them.

KEY AGENTS (by structural relationship):
- observant_households: dual-positioned participant (moderate/identity_locked) — bears the annual time cost, receives rehearsal benefit when engaged as training
- descendant_generations: silent beneficiary (powerless/trapped) — inherits the stored procedural repertoire or its absence
- symbol_processing_participants: cost-bearing participant (moderate/identity_locked) — performs the cycle as heritage commemoration, receiving little operational yield under this reading
- rabbinic_transmitters: agenda_setter (institutional/identity_locked) — codifies calendar and liturgy, maintains form; collects continuity of office, not material rent
- secular_risk_educators: excluded alternative provider (moderate/mobile) — offers measured explicit training outside the communal conversation
- ritual_studies_scholars: analytical observer (analytical/analytical) — produces the comparative efficacy evidence
commentary.logic_rationale: Extraction is modest (0.34 at interval end): the cycle takes real household time annually, but for engaged participants the cost purchases the rehearsal itself, and no material goods move. It rises slowly across the interval because the operational referent (imminent catastrophe) receded for many communities after emancipation, leaving the same time cost attached to a thinner felt necessity. Suppression is low and falling (0.24): the kehillah-era enforcement machinery dissolved; persistence is now carried by identity and volition, not coercion — the suppression_requirement series tracks that enforcement decay deliberately, since the story's central dynamic is persistence surviving the loss of its coercive scaffolding. Theater_ratio is the load-bearing metric (0.42 and climbing): under THIS reading, observance processed as heritage performance rather than rehearsal is performative relative to the arrangement's own function, and the historical record shows that share growing. Accessibility_collapse is low (0.30): explicit alternatives — evacuation drills, written protocols, secular scenario training — remain fully constructible; nothing about the arrangement forecloses them, which is precisely why the reading needs its second axiom (embodied rehearsal outlasts written instruction) rather than resting on inevitability. Resistance is moderate-low (0.30): attrition through assimilation and occasional rejection of ritual obligation, not organized opposition. All three series run on one shared time grid (points 0, 6, 12, 18, 24, 30; stylized decade-scale steps across the modern observance era) so no metric row borrows another's endpoints.
commentary.perspectival_gap: Four seats experience the same annual practice differently, and the engine should compute that divergence from the structural data. Engaged observant households sit near symmetric: they pay hours and receive training. Symbol-processing participants sit target-side: identical cost, negligible yield under this reading — for them the arrangement operates as uncompensated extraction wearing training's clothing. Descendant generations sit at the pure-beneficiary extreme with zero voice: the entire arrangement is conducted on their behalf without their consent. Rabbinic transmitters see the system they steward: from that seat the cycle is continuity itself, and its theater share is invisible because fidelity to form IS the seat's success criterion. No single-seat classification of this constraint is correct; the divergence is the finding.
commentary.directionality_logic: Beneficiary/victim declarations drive the derivation: observant_households (declared beneficiary, secondary payer, identity_locked) derive near-symmetric d; symbol_processing_participants (declared victim, identity_locked) derive high d — identity lock amplifies their target-side position because they cannot exit the cost; descendant_generations are declared beneficiaries but carry powerless/trapped atoms, which the derivation normally reads as target-side amplification. That reading would be wrong here: the trap is inheriting a benefit, not bearing a cost, and futurity is invisible to the derivation chain — hence the explicit override pinning the powerless atom to d=0.08. Rabbinic_transmitters derive low-moderate d (agenda_setter plus beneficiary) correctly: they collect continuity of office and standing, not material rents, so their benefit is real but does not constitute capture. Secular_risk_educators are excluded rather than governed — the constraint does not extract from them; their exclusion is the counterfactual against which accessibility_collapse is scored.
commentary.mandatrophy_analysis: The founding problem — recurrent catastrophic disruption erasing communities that carried no portable survival procedure — is authored as live: state-based disaster protection is recent, unevenly distributed, and absent in exactly the displacement scenarios the repertoire addresses, so the mandate has not outlived its function and mandatrophy_resolved is not declared. The live founding_problem_status paired with world_rearranges disappearance verdict produces no zombie flag, correctly. But the theater trajectory is the early-warning path this reading must watch: if operational engagement continues thinning while form persists, the arrangement drifts toward piton — a training regimen maintained theatrically by administrators who could revise it but bear too little of the cost of its emptiness to do so. Classifying the arrangement as rope now prevents the opposite error: reading voluntary, identity-carried persistence as coercion would mislabel a low-suppression coordination mechanism as a snare, and demanding snare-grade victims would manufacture them from what is under this reading a comprehension failure, pending the symbol_substance_mistake_asymmetry omega.

network.dual_formulation_note: Constraint family: the colloquial label 'catastrophe-memory ritual' conflates three structurally distinct claims and is decomposed per the epsilon-invariance principle into three stories sharing the kernel catastrophe_memory_transmission. This file authors the operational_competence_reading (epsilon referent: the standing observance cycle assessed by operational yield; beneficiary: future survival capacity; mild extraction via the symbol-processing asymmetry). The symbol_continuity_reading sibling authors the same observance cycle as intrinsic identity-good (different beneficiary seat, theater-tolerant). The hybrid_embedded_reading sibling authors the inseparability claim (no yield-evaluation possible, no victim class). The upstream/downstream edge runs from this reading to both siblings because operational-yield evaluation, where attempted, changes the legitimacy conditions under which the other readings defend fidelity: pruning by yield presupposes separability, which is exactly what the siblings deny or bracket.

stakeholders.name: observant_households
stakeholders.situation: Conduct the annual cycle — the seder with its departure-posture and unleavened-bread elements, the summer fast with its scarcity discipline, the memorial calendar — contributing hours of preparation and observance each year. When they engage the practices as rehearsal, the cost purchases the training directly. Leaving the practice would cost communal belonging beyond the ritual itself, so participation persists even where engagement thins.

stakeholders.name: descendant_generations
stakeholders.situation: Not yet present. Will inherit whatever procedural repertoire the annual cycle successfully stores — rehearsed departure habits, scarcity-endurance templates, threat-recognition heuristics — or its absence. Cannot consent to, refuse, or modify the training they receive; their entire situation is set by transmission quality today, and they bear no cost of the arrangement, only its outcome.

stakeholders.name: symbol_processing_participants
stakeholders.situation: Perform the same annual obligations but process them as heritage commemoration — attending to narrative, food, and family meaning rather than operational content. Bear the full time cost every year. Under this reading they receive little of the competence yield, because the training value depends on engaging the practices as rehearsal of departure, scarcity, and threat response. They remain inside the practice because exit would surrender communal identity they did not choose to forfeit.

stakeholders.name: rabbinic_transmitters
stakeholders.situation: Codify and administer the cycle: fix calendar dates, redact and transmit the liturgies, rule on exemptions, teach the practices, decide what counts as faithful performance. Maintain the arrangement's form across dispersion and persecution. Collect continuity of office, standing, and meaning from the cycle's persistence; collect no material rent from it. Their authority is constituted by faithful transmission, which makes revising the form toward operational clarity a threat to their own position.

stakeholders.name: secular_risk_educators
stakeholders.situation: Emergency-management trainers, survival instructors, and museum educators who offer explicit, measurable alternatives — evacuation drills, certification courses, scenario exercises — delivering comparable competence without ritual form. Stand outside the communal conversation: their proposals are rarely adopted inside observant communities, and they rarely design delivery mechanisms compatible with ritual-encoded transmission.

stakeholders.name: ritual_studies_scholars
stakeholders.situation: Researchers in collective memory, cognitive science of religion, and ritual studies who examine how ritual stores and transmits procedural knowledge. Take no part in observance decisions. Produce the comparative evidence — drilled versus undrilled community outcomes, embodied versus written retention — that would confirm or refute the operational reading's core claim.

six_questions.coordination_function: Stores and re-transmits non-propositional survival procedure — rapid-departure sequencing, scarcity rationing, threat-recognition heuristics — across generations and dispersions, using an annual embodied rehearsal cycle that survives the conditions (book destruction, language shift, institutional collapse, forced migration) that destroy written records and formal training institutions.
six_questions.transfer_function: Moves several hours of household time and attention per year, from every observing household, into a distributed procedural memory held communally; moves encoded survival procedure forward to successor generations; extracts no material goods from any participant.
six_questions.absent_voices: Descendant generations — the arrangement's designated beneficiaries — cannot appear: they receive whatever transmission quality results and cannot object to its dilution. Secular risk-management educators stand outside the communal conversation; inside it, questions of measured drill efficacy rarely displace questions of liturgical fidelity, so the strongest critics of the operational claim are never seated where the practice is decided.
six_questions.disappearance_rationale: The communal calendar, the educational sequence, and the identity schedule are built around the cycle; overnight removal would strand the stored repertoire unrehearsed, with procedural decay setting in within a few generations, and communities facing subsequent displacement would act on untrained judgment where rehearsed response previously operated. Households would also lose the annual structure around which family gathering and instruction currently organize.
six_questions.founding_problem: Recurrent catastrophe — destruction, expulsion, pogrom — repeatedly erased communities that carried no portable survival procedure. The cycle was built so that each catastrophe's operational lessons (leave fast, endure scarcity, read escalation signs early) would be rehearsed annually rather than relearned per crisis or lost between them.
six_questions.founding_problem_corroboration: Partial, from outside the benefiting parties: historical-demographic work on expelled communities re-establishing refuge and trade networks; documented rapid-flight behavior in later persecutions consistent with rehearsed departure patterns; ritual-studies and cognitive-science literature treating ritual as durable procedural memory. No controlled demonstration isolates ritual rehearsal as the causal survival factor — corroboration is convergent, not experimental, and this limitation is stated plainly rather than resolved by assertion.
